name: What information do I need before replacing a kitchen sink and faucet together?
description: Check hole count, sink dimensions, valve condition, countertop cutout, and clearance before you shop or schedule installation.

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before replacing a kitchen sink and faucet together?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should check the **mounting holes**, shutoff valve condition, and available clearance before buying anything. If you are replacing both pieces, it is also smart to confirm countertop cutout size and whether the sink supports the faucet style you want.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check hole count, sink dimensions, valve condition, countertop cutout, and clearance before you shop or schedule installation.
